'''Riding''' is a tier one [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Rider]], a [[unit]] with more movement but less defence than the [[Warrior]]. The [[Oumaji]] and [[Aquarion]] tribes start with Riding. 

For [[Aquarion]], Riding unlocks the [[Amphibian]], a special unit that replaces the Rider, and movement on shallow water. 

For [[Cymanti]], Riding unlocks the [[Hexapod]], an agile, high-attack, but low-health special unit that replaces the Rider. 

Riding's branches in the technology tree are focused on "destructive aspects."<ref>{{cite web|author = Midjiwan|title = DevBlog: Balance Pass 1|website = Steam|date = 20 Apr 2021|link = https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/874390/view/4855419242367147448|quote = Thematically, Clear Forest fits well with the destructive aspects of the Riding branch (Disband ability, Clear Forest, Burn Forest)...}}</ref>
